rca of the issue: Real bug: in high-traffic VIP group @GCBLACKPEARL, the join button is a URL deep-link (https://t.me/fish_it_vip_bot?start=daftar2_...) pushed past the 12-message scan window by leaderboard spam. Additionally, every group message was logged to activity DB, saturating the event loop. Fix (verified by tests): (1) _join_group_button polls ~20s and scans 50 messages, recognizing join by deep-link targeting cfg.bot_username or label containing daftar/mancing; sends /start <param> and stores as _pending_after_verify; (2) _wait_for_any only logs message-in events for configured bot chat or known state patterns (pendaftaran/cancelled/waktu_habis/session/inventory/verification/registration/boost).
